item.title: Michael Duarte cause of death: How did the food influencer FoodWithBearHands die
item.description: Beloved food creator Michael Duarte, known as FoodWithBearHands, tragically passed away in Texas on November 8, 2025, during a family trip. His sudden death, described as a "horrible incident," has left millions of fans mourning the loss of his cheerful personality and culinary talent. Duarte, a devoted husband and father, inspired many with his generosity and passion for food.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Who is GrassHopper? The Hungarian streamer who played Dance Dance Revolution for six days straight
item.description: Hungarian gamer Szabolcs “GrassHopper” Csépe has shattered the Dance Dance Revolution world record, playing for six consecutive days. This achievement, surpassing the previous 138-hour record, highlights his immense endurance and dedication. GrassHopper's success was attributed to months of rigorous preparation, including diet, hydration, and physical training, alongside a dedicated support team.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Who was Michael Duarte? FoodWithBearHands influencer dies suddenly in Texas days after celebrating nine years with wife Jessica
item.description: Beloved food creator Michael Duarte, known as FoodWithBearHands, tragically passed away in a Texas accident on November 8, 2025. Celebrating nine years of marriage just days prior, Duarte, a devoted husband and father of one, inspired millions with his accessible cooking and BBQ videos. His talent agency and family are mourning the loss of this kind and hardworking influencer.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Candace Owens and CNN clash after receipts reveal she agreed to discuss Charlie Kirk in interview despite public claim
item.description: Candace Owens and CNN are clashing over an interview where Owens claims CNN violated her request not to discuss Charlie Kirk's death. While Owens' team initially stated no discussion, later emails show they agreed to a "tasteful" and limited mention. Both sides have released email "receipts" to support their differing accounts of the agreement.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Michael Duarte net worth in 2025: FoodWithBearHands influencer’s earnings, wife Jessica, and tragic Texas accident
item.description: Beloved California food influencer Michael Duarte, known as FoodWithBearHands, tragically passed away in Texas in November 2025 following a "horrible accident." Duarte, who amassed over two million followers across social media platforms, was estimated to have a net worth nearing $1 million. He is survived by his wife, Jessica, and their six-year-old daughter, Oakley.

item.title: Did Tectone just call out Twitch’s hypocrisy on Veterans Day?
item.description: Streamer Tectone accused Twitch of hypocrisy over its Veterans Day tribute, claiming he was banned for defending soldiers against a woman who allegedly wished them PTSD. His viral post highlights perceived inconsistencies in Twitch's moderation, sparking debate about the platform's enforcement of community guidelines and its commitment to supporting veterans.

item.title: Destiny makes explosive allegation against HasanAbi involving a minor girl during Berlin trip
item.description: Online streamer Destiny has accused fellow streamer HasanAbi of inappropriate conduct with a minor during a visit to a Berlin brothel. This serious allegation emerged after a heated exchange regarding Destiny's past association with Nick Fuentes. HasanAbi has previously admitted to visiting a brothel but has not addressed Destiny's specific claim, which remains unverified.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Who is Brittany Miller? TikTok star admits faking cancer after years of lies and viral fame
item.description: Brittany Miller, a popular TikTok star, has admitted to a shocking lie. In 2017, she claimed to have stomach cancer. This deception garnered sympathy and donations. However, the truth has now emerged. Miller confessed she fabricated the illness during a difficult period. She was later convicted of fraud. Miller expresses regret and seeks to take responsibility for her actions.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: ‘US is the one that won wars’: Trump boasts about WWII victory while minimising allies’ role in Veterans Day speech
item.description: President Trump declared a new "Victory Day" for U.S. wars, asserting American military triumphs surpass those of allies. He criticized Western partners for celebrating their own victory days while the U.S. did not.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Indian-origin man finds 80-year-old neighbour dead in US, shares story on Instagram: ‘I’ll take care of final rites’
item.description: An Indian man in the US shared a viral video detailing the lonely death of his 80-year-old neighbor, Shafar, who was found deceased in his apartment. The man, Sachin Sindhu, expressed concern over the isolation of elderly Americans, contrasting it with the closer family structures often found in India.

item.title: 3I/ATLAS: Are these the most detailed images yet of our new interstellar visitor?
item.description: A new interstellar comet, 3I/ATLAS, is passing through our Solar System. This rare visitor comes from deep space, carrying clues about planet formation elsewhere. Astronomers are studying it closely. The comet will reach its closest point to Earth in December 2025. It poses no threat to our planet. This is a unique chance to understand alien chemistry.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Ilhan Omar hits back after Donald Trump mocks her quoting US Constitution: ‘Unlike you, I can read’
item.description: President Trump's remarks questioning Congresswoman Ilhan Omar's right to comment on US politics due to her foreign background sparked a sharp retort. Omar, who fled Somalia's civil war, countered by highlighting her ability to read the Constitution, unlike the President. This exchange follows previous instances where Trump suggested she should "go back" to Somalia.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Donald Trump to sue BBC for $1 billion: What he actually said vs what the BBC Panorama documentary claimed he said
item.description: Former U.S. President Donald Trump is threatening to sue the BBC for at least $1 billion over a misleading edit of his January 6 speech. The BBC documentary stitched together two separate statements, creating the impression of a continuous call to march on the Capitol. The broadcaster has acknowledged the error and apologized, leading to resignations at the top.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Foster mother forcing me to change my faith': Hindu Indian woman adopted by Americans seeks help to return
item.description: “I am a Hindu but my foster mother is forcing me to change my faith,” teh 21-year-old woman from Odisha who was adopted by an American couple back in 2018 when she was 14 years old said. The woman identified as Puja alias Sejal said her visa expired in 2023 and now she has no legal protection in the US.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Donald Trump reveals what first lady Melania thinks about new $300 million White House ballroom: 'If you ask her, she’d say...'
item.description: President Trump announced that First Lady Melania Trump now supports the $300 million plan to replace the East Wing with a new ballroom, despite initial reservations. Construction has begun on the 90,000 square foot facility, which Trump claims is funded by donations, though Democrats have voiced strong opposition to the demolition of the historic East Wing.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: “I don’t have any patriotism for America”: Hasan Piker faces backlash after holding Chinese flag during livestream in Beijing
item.description: Twitch streamer Hasan Piker declared a lack of patriotism for America while at Tiananmen Square in Beijing, holding a Chinese flag. The livestreamed moment, shared widely, sparked debate. Earlier, Chinese security briefly detained Piker and his team over a Chairman Mao meme on his screen, before allowing them to continue filming.
